def wrap(text, width):
    """Word-wrap text into a list of lines with given width."""
    if width < 1:
        raise ValueError("width must be at least 1")
    
    words = text.split()
    if not words:
        return []
    
    lines = []
    current_line = ""
    
    for word in words:
        # Handle words longer than width by cutting them into pieces
        while len(word) > width:
            piece = word[:width]
            word = word[width:]
            
            # Place the piece as a word
            if not current_line:
                current_line = piece
            elif len(current_line) + 1 + len(piece) <= width:
                current_line += " " + piece
            else:
                lines.append(current_line)
                current_line = piece
        
        # Now place the remaining word (which is <= width)
        if not current_line:
            current_line = word
        elif len(current_line) + 1 + len(word) <= width:
            current_line += " " + word
        else:
            lines.append(current_line)
            current_line = word
    
    if current_line:
        lines.append(current_line)
    
    return lines

        # Additional test cases (corrected to match spec)
        (("hello world", 11), ["hello world"]),  # fits exactly
        (("hello world", 10), ["hello", "world"]),  # doesn't fit
        (("a", 1), ["a"]),  # single char
        (("a b c", 1), ["a", "b", "c"]),  # width 1
        (("longword", 3), ["lon", "gwo", "rd"]),  # word longer than width
        (("a longword b", 3), ["a", "lon", "gwo", "rd", "b"]),  # long word in middle
        (("  spaced  out  ", 5), ["space", "d out"]),  # leading/trailing/multiple spaces - "spaced" (6) > 5, so cut
        (("word", 10), ["word"]),  # single word shorter than width
        (("word", 4), ["word"]),  # single word exactly width
        (("word", 3), ["wor", "d"]),  # single word longer than width
        (("a bc def", 3), ["a", "bc", "def"]),  # "a bc" = 4 > 3, so separate lines
        (("a bc def", 2), ["a", "bc", "de", "f"]),  # tight width

        (("a verylongword b", 5), ["a", "veryl", "ongwo", "rd", "b"]),  # long word in middle
    ]
    
    passed = 0
    failed = 0
    
    for i, (args, expected) in enumerate(tests):

                failed += 1

            if expected is ValueError:
                print(f"Test {i+1}: PASS (ValueError raised)")
                passed += 1
            else:
                print(f"Test {i+1}: FAIL - Unexpected ValueError: {e}")
                failed += 1
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Test {i+1}: FAIL - Unexpected exception: {e}")
            failed += 1
    
    print(f"\nPassed: {passed}, Failed: {failed}")
    if failed == 0:
        print("ALL TESTS PASSED")
    else:
        print("NOT ALL TESTS PASSED")
